intent: Create provenance-bearing writing or structural artifacts from supplied material and explicit canon across eight distinct routes.
successCondition: A single bounded route returns a local artifact, refusal, or handoff.

direct: write precise technical prose from supplied facts
produce a report or document without inventing completion
extract and review structure from a bounded source
paraphrased: make the draft shorter without losing meaning
turn the evidence into a stakeholder narrative
show the seams, gaps, and invariants in this material
contextual: a source-backed local writing artifact is needed
the narrative must preserve voice and uncertainty
a structural reading should precede a later draft
